text:
alex.t: Quick heads-up — ACME security asked for per-question evidence on SIG v2, starting with Q3.1 (encryption at rest). Can we assemble artifacts? Need by Wed EOD. cc @maria

maria: Got it. Sam, can you pull KMS policy + rotation proof? Also S3 bucket encryption config and disk encryption for instances.

samir: On it. I have KMS key ARN & rotation enabled. Will export key policy and a terraform snippet. ping if you need logs.

jordan: Customer wants explicit timestamps for last rotation and who owns key. Also a short one-paragraph explanation is required.

alex.t: We should include: (1) KMS policy + last_rotate timestamp, (2) S3 default encryption config, (3) EBS volume encryption setting, (4) SOC/third-party cert line referencing. Keep everything redacted for customer.

samir: Dropping artifacts to drive. Links: https://our-internal-drive/acme/sig/3_1/kms-policy.pdf and https://our-internal-drive/acme/sig/3_1/s3-config.json

secops-bot: Artifact uploaded by samir: kms-policy.pdf (checksum: abc123).

maria: I also have a screenshot from the console showing rotation on 2025-11-02 and rotation schedule 'automatic'. Will attach.

jordan: Customer point: They want clarifying language about BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys. We should state supported models.

alex.t: Proposed blurb: 'Redwood supports customer-managed KMS keys (BYOK) and platform-managed keys. For Private deployments, BYOK is recommended; for Hosted we provide dedicated keys per-customer with automated rotation.' Can someone refine?

maria: Looks good. Minor tweak: 'automated rotation with 90-day rotation cadence configurable by customer.'

samir: Included code snippet for S3 default encryption in repo: ```resource "aws_s3_bucket" "data_bucket" { bucket = "redwood-tenant-bucket" server_side_encryption_configuration { rule { apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" kms_master_key_id = "alias/redwood-key" } } } }``` I'll paste full in the doc.

jordan: I'll send this bundle to ACME with a short cover note and the zip. Can we confirm no secrets in attachments?

maria: Confirmed — redacted. I scanned with internal scanner (https://scanner.internal/acme) and removed ARNs with production IDs.

kelly: Thanks team — quick ask: can you show proof where encryption-at-rest keys are isolated per-tenant in hosted mode?

alex.t: Replying: yes — each tenant’s model data lives in separate buckets and keys are per-tenant. We'll include a simplified diagram. Samir, can you add that diagram?

samir: Added diagram: https://our-internal-drive/acme/sig/3_1/tenant-key-diagram.png

secops-bot: Document bundle created: acme_sig_Q3_1_bundle_2025-12-12.zip (checksum: def456)

alex.t: Thanks all. Jordan please ping me if ACME asks follow-ups. Maria, Sam — please keep these artifacts in the shared folder for audit.

jordan: :thumbsup: I'll send now and update thread.

maria: If they request BYOK onboarding steps, I can draft a short runbook (KMS grant flow + verification checklist).

samir: I'll also add a sample terraform snippet for customer-managed keys to the runbook.

alex.t: Perfect. Closing the loop — target: send bundle today and mark SIG Q3.1 as 'answered' in the tracker.
